patent.title: System and method for analyzing patent documents using machine learning
patent.abstract: A computer implemented workflow ingests patent documents, extracts structured features, compares references, and presents ranked research results for review.

sections.text: 1. A computer implemented method comprising receiving patent document text, extracting metadata and citations, storing normalized records, and presenting a research interface configured to compare related patent documents.

Patent research commonly requires review of claims, descriptions, classification codes, and citation relationships. Local persistence allows repeated review and annotation without re-fetching source documents.
The disclosed system combines structured patent import, citation graph storage, notes, reference lists, and generated research artifacts.
